title: USB Power Delivery sink (UFP): BMC on CC, SOP / HardReset ordered sets, CRC-32, GoodCRC, Source_Capabilities -> Request -> Accept -> PS_RDY negotiation picking the 9 V PDO, Reject, renegotiation, MessageIDCounter with GoodCRC timeout and retries

fields.desc: explicit contract established (PS_RDY received); same as the vbus_ok pin

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: bad CRC, bad EOP or more than two objects (no GoodCRC sent), a GoodCRC with the wrong MessageID, or a Request given up after its retries. Held in the core until the next good message or a HardReset, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: cc_rxd (CC line level in), cc_txd / cc_tx_en (BMC drive and its enable) and vbus_ok pass through unchanged. One BMC unit interval is one PCLK.
Messages travel on the CC wire only; the registers report the contract state and protocol errors.
